description: This is a shell script file containing a comprehensive set of tests for a diff engine, focusing on whitespace handling, move detection, color highlighting, and other diff functionality aspects. It includes test cases simulating various whitespace scenarios, move detection, coloring, and configuration interactions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting specific outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks for specific exit codes in tests.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures a command fails as expected in tests.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that output is empty for certain tests.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files and message.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes color escape sequences into human-readable form.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Outputs specified lines to a file.

methods.name: q_to_tab
methods.description: Replaces Q placeholders with tab characters for whitespace testing.
